newsitem.title: USA: NFL-CHARGERS LB SEAU TO MISS FOUR WEEKS FOLLOWING KNEE SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: NFL-CHARGERS LB SEAU TO MISS FOUR WEEKS FOLLOWING KNEE SURGERY.

text.p: San Diego Chargers All-Pro linebacker Junior Seau underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left knee Monday and could miss the team's season opener against the New England Patriots.
Seau, the heart and soul of the Chargers defence, is expected to miss up to four weeks after doctors repaired cartilage damage in his left knee.
He played the first three series of Saturday's 20-13 exhibition win over San Francisco before leaving with an injury. An MRI taken Sunday revealed the cartilage damage.

The 28-year-old Seau was voted to his sixth straight Pro Bowl last season. He led the Chargers with 138 tackles and seven sacks, adding two interceptions, one forced fumble and three fumble recoveries.
Defensive end Don Sasa also will be sidelined up to a month following similar surgery to repair cartilage damage in his left knee. Sasa was also hurt in Saturday's game against the 49ers.
The 24-year-old Sasa was on the inactive list for 11 of the first 15 games last season, but made his first NFL start in San Diego's season finale against the Denver Broncos.
